senses.gloss: ज्ञेय mfn. to be known (e.g. ज्ञेयो महार्णवोऽत्र, it should be known that there is here a great sea, VarBṛS. xiv, 19; कथं न ज्ञेयम् अस्माभिर् निवर्तितुम्, how should we not know how to leave off, Bhag. i, 39), Mn.; Yājñ.; R. &c.
to be learnt or understood or ascertained or investigated or perceived or inquired about, ŚvetUp. i, 12; MBh. iii, 2737; Nal. &c.
ज्ञेय—ज्ञ m. ‘understanding what is to be understood’, the mind, Yājñ. iii, 154.
ज्ञेय—ता f. intelligibleness, KapS. i, 96, Sch.
ज्ञेय—मल्लक m. pl. N. of a people, MārkP. lvii.
ज्ञेयार्णव m. the ocean of knowledge, Bcar. vii, 56.
